descripcion_html:
Somos el mayor proveedor de fibra óptica del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones integrales y con una cartera de productos diversa y flexible, con especial presencia en las industrias de las telecomunicaciones, servicios públicos, transporte, petroquímica y médica. En el Perú estamos a cargo del Proyecto Regional para implementar fibra óptica en 4 regiones del País (Arequipa, Ancash, San Martín y La Libertad) y requerimos profesionales con experiencia para nuestro staff

We are looking for a Senior Microwave Engineer to integrate, configure, commission, and troubleshoot Nokia PTP/PTMP microwave links. The role involves ensuring optimal link performance, resolving technical issues, supporting field and NOC teams, and contributing to network capacity expansion and optimization.

¿What will you do?

  • Integrate, configure, and commission Nokia PTP/PTMP microwave equipment.

  • Troubleshoot microwave links, including RSSI, BER, interference, alarms, capacity, and availability issues.

  • Validate link alignment, performance, and connectivity.

  • Participate in capacity upgrades, frequency changes, and equipment replacements.

  • Provide technical support to field and NOC teams during integrations and incident resolution.

  • Analyze link performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Document configurations, test results, incidents, and integration progress.


Requisitos:
¿What do we need?

  • Bachelor's degree or professional degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Wireless Communications, or a related field.

  • Experience in integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of PTP/PTMP microwave networks.

  • Hands-on experience with Nokia microwave equipment.

  • Knowledge of link budgets, frequencies, capacity, RSSI, BER, and interference.

  • Knowledge of Ethernet, IP, VLANs, and basic routing.

  • Basic knowledge of DWDM and optical transport networks.

  • Ability to troubleshoot issues and identify the point of failure before escalating.

  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency (indispensable).

  • Availability to travel to field sites as required.


Beneficios What We Offer

  • Employment on the payroll with all legally mandated benefits.

  • Career growth opportunities.

  • A positive work environment.
